description: neuralese-e2e-v1 on Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B (DGX). Backbone-inherent: MuonSR latent_lr 1e-5 (as the direct stage), maple output convention and Mellum's measured base gate_pass in the monitor, Mellum's QAT component held at the parent's progress, the pinned BF16 base snapshot. Fit-only: memory_gb 102 (the 121 GB unified-memory envelope with the stage alone on the machine), checkpointed layers, auto backward routing. A launch recipe extends this one and binds input_bindings.direct_artifact (and, from a mid-lineage snapshot, quantization.stage_progress.e2e).

reference.source: BF16 Mellum2.1 (raw-token-v1 heads) on the 48 shared probes, 28/48 with the maple tool-call convention (runs/neuralese-direct-line-parity-20261011/mellum-base-gate-48.json texts, rescored mellum-base-gate-48-maple.json)

quantization.description: Mellum's precision points (the shared q4 plus ternary-experts and ternary, as neuralese-direct-mellum-v4) in the end-to-end stage, held at its parent's curriculum progress on the shared allocation: after the full direct lineage that is 1.0 (every point at lambda 1). A launch from a mid-lineage snapshot holds the snapshot's progress instead (its launch recipe overrides stage_progress.e2e).
